messages:
June (Product): quick pulse before the pricing workshop — we need a final call on: trial soft-cap behavior, reserved-slot billing, and onboarding credit format.
Omar (Finance): recommended primitives: commit term (monthly/annual), reserved slots charged as $280/slot/month + $0.17/slot-hour. onboarding credit = USD one-off applied to first invoice.
Rae (Sales): field feedback: mid-market customers want a named 30-day "Launch Buffer" that they can show execs. prefer it in contract as a bullet they can reference. also request 1 worked-dollar example per tier (no token math).
Marta (Legal): propose clause: "Launch Buffer: first 30 days after provisioning billed at list; customer may request discretionary credit within 60 days; Provider not obligated to grant refunds." add 30-day downsize notice for annual reserved slots.
Ken (Eng): ops note: reserved slots require pre-warmed pools; add 30-day amortization minimum to avoid churn. priority-routing add-on is region-gated (US first).
BillingBot: billing-config v4.1 applied to staging 2026-03-21T20:02:01Z (CI #6222) :white_check_mark:
June (Product): product decision: publish 3 tiers (Starter, Growth, Enterprise). Starter = metered, Growth = 1 slot + 100M burst tokens (quarterly/annual), Enterprise = custom slots + SLA. Priority-routing = per-slot add-on. onboarding credit in USD applied to first invoice; Launch Buffer = 30 days billed at list with discretionary review. I'll update the deck and share by 14:30.
Omar (Finance): include an amortization example and one worked sample invoice.
Rae (Sales): will prep customer one-pager after deck.
Marta (Legal): will upload redlines to term sheet by 17:00.
